policy.stationVisibility: Every EVSE from the current Swiss national source remains in the bundle regardless of CPO complete/blocked/partial status.
policy.tariffOverlay: Only validated deterministic direct-tariff production artifacts are overlaid. Missing tariff never removes an EVSE.
policy.blockedCpoHandling: Blocked/partial is CPO-level research metadata only; resolved EVSE prices inside such CPOs remain publishable.
policy.otherPriceLayers: Electra, Electroverse and subscription-adjusted prices are intentionally separate runtime overlays and are not replaced by this direct-CPO bundle.

CH*CCI.note: 1876/1876 current CH*CCI EVSEs priced from explicit Move non-roaming CPO-level AC/DC tariff schedules; prices_per_station_available=false, exact EVSE AC/DC matching, no station extrapolation.

CH*SUI.name: Swisscharge
CH*SUI.note: 2445/2445 current CH*SUI EVSEs deterministically resolved for the current snapshot: 2411 with numeric tariffs and 34 explicitly classified as having no current public direct tariff. Temporary unavailable states are rechecked on future refreshes; no tariff extrapolation.

CH*MIG.name: Migrol / M-Charge
CH*MIG.note: Official Migrol national M-Charge power-tier tariff reconciled to current OICP power: 1031/1031 EVSE priced.

CH*SHE.name: Shell Recharge / evpass
CH*SHE.note: 1171/1171 current national EVSEs priced from evpass official Switzerland tariff tiers, using each EVSE's own national-feed power; no roaming or cross-station extrapolation.

CH*TSL.name: Tesla Supercharger
CH*TSL.note: Tesla scope is handled by the dedicated Tesla weekly source/process, not the CPO direct-tariff queue.

CH*EPO.name: EPO
CH*EPO.note: 0/324 deterministic direct prices. Exhaustive current public-path analysis completed: official QR route is decoded and Eponet Go APK exposes production api.eponet.io plus ocpp/rate/getrates/, but map/detail/rate APIs return 403 without account authentication and current QR URLs use opaque 32-hex tokens. 8 Charger IDs covering 23 current EVSEs are known, but no current-snapshot public-charge token was found in indexed QR files/photos or public directories. Fail closed; no brute force or tariff extrapolation.
CH*EPO.resumeCondition: Resume when a current-snapshot Eponet QR/label photo or exact public-charge URL is found, or if the user explicitly provides/authorizes an authenticated Eponet app session.

CH*POW.name: PowerUp by AGROLA
CH*POW.note: 235/235 current national EVSEs priced. 233 from Monta public CPO pricing export; 2 residual Laupen EVSEs closed by direct Monta public payment pages. No extrapolation.

CH*IWB.name: IWB
CH*IWB.note: 472/472 current national CH*IWB EVSEs deterministically resolved. The final six Basel-Landschaft residual EVSEs were resolved by the IWB-branded Swisscharge public ad-hoc tenant (Industrielle-Werke-Basel_CH) using exact EVSE physical references: 247322, 247323, 35375, 35376, 46250 and 46251. Exact tariffs are preserved including time-of-day/duration components; no Basel-Stadt tariff extrapolation was used.

CH*SCH.name: Saascharge
CH*SCH.note: 226/226 current national EVSEs priced from Saascharge published Switzerland Gireve tariff bands by exact EVSE power/type; no extrapolation.

CH*AVI.name: AVIA
CH*AVI.note: 583/583 current national CH*AVI EVSEs deterministically resolved. 582 match the AVIA VOLT guest backend by exact EVSE ID across AVAILABLE + NOT_AVAILABLE map scopes; the sole national residual CH*AVI*E10599 is deterministically mapped to its live successor CH*AVI*EEB0C096A*1*1 at Garage Muzzarelli AG Tankstelle Schiers by identical location/address/coordinates, connector type and 11 kW power. No tariff extrapolation.

CH*PLN.name: Plenitude On The Road

CH*EBS.name: EBS / ebs Energie AG
CH*EBS.note: 6/6 current national CH*EBS EVSEs deterministically resolved. Sahli (CH*EBS*E123*0009) is co-located within 0.3 m with Swisscharge EVSEs CH*SUI*E252166/E252167 at the same Talstation Luftseilbahn Sahli-Glattalp site. Swisscharge's public ad-hoc backend returns tariff id 269019 explicitly named for ebs Energie AG, applyToAdHocUsers=true, CHF 0.47/kWh with zero connection/duration/idle fees. No extrapolation.

CH*EDH.name: Energiedienst CH
CH*EDH.note: 16/16 current national EVSEs exactly reconciled and priced.

CH*EVT.name: CH*EVT
CH*EVT.note: 5/8 deterministically resolved. Only #2395 Kobiboden 57 remains (3 EVSEs: 50 kW DC, 22 kW AC, 100 kW DC). Exact parking.ch backend confirms Direct Payment but exposes no tariff/payment URL. Nearby AVC-SYSTEM Swisscharge EVSEs are AC-only and cannot resolve the EVTEC DC channels. EVTEC documentation indicates station costs are displayed locally on the charger/payment terminal.
CH*EVT.resumeCondition: Obtain a current photo/screen readout from the #2395 charger after selecting AC and DC connectors, or a station-owner/payment-terminal backend record that exposes the exact tariff. Do not map the nearby AC-only Swisscharge tariff to EVTEC DC.

CH*AMG.note: 10/10 CH*AMG EVSEs are current CH*AUTOSENSE-owned AMAG Charging Stations; standard public tariff CHF 0.56/kWh, conditional eligible-brand/app tariff CHF 0.28/kWh stored separately.

CH*HER.name: CH*HER
CH*HER.note: 0/1 after deep closeout. Postparkplatz Herrliberg / Forchstrasse 16 is confirmed by current municipal documentation as the municipality's public 150 kW DC fast charger. Exact parking.ch backend confirms Direct Payment but exposes no price or payment URL. Community CHF 0.39/kWh remains non-authoritative and is not promoted.
CH*HER.resumeCondition: Obtain the current Postparkplatz payment-terminal/charger display tariff, a Gemeinde/EWH tariff publication, or a payment backend response. Do not promote the community CHF 0.39/kWh value without authoritative confirmation.

CH*ECU.name: eCarUp
